```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: false
          node-version: '16'
          cache-node-modules: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run tests
        run: yarn test

      - name: Check for flaky tests
        id: check_flakiness
        run: |
          # Assuming flaky tests are identified by a specific keyword in the output
          if grep -q "Flaky test detected" $(find . -name "*.log"); then
            echo "::set-output name=flaky::true"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=flaky::false"
          fi

      - name: Trigger re-run if flaky tests detected
        if: ${{ steps.check_flakiness.outputs.flaky == 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "Flaky tests detected. Re-running the workflow..."
          curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
               -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
               -d '{"event_type": "re-run"}' \
               https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/dispatches
```
